title: Circles
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings, word problems, and an 'is this right?' item. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation in JavaScript form (answers in terms of π give the number in front of π), or 'yes'/'no'; the test checks the answer key's number against it.

items.prompt: Find the circumference of a circle with diameter 14 cm, in terms of π.
Find the circumference of a circle with radius 6 m, in terms of π.
Find the area of a circle with radius 7 in, in terms of π.
Find the area of a circle with diameter 10 ft, in terms of π.
A round pond has a radius of 3 m. What is its area, in terms of π?
Kai says a circle with diameter 8 cm has area 64π cm². Is he right? Explain, and find the area.
Find the circumference of a circle with diameter 20 cm, in terms of π.
Find the circumference of a circle with radius 9 ft, in terms of π.
Find the area of a circle with radius 4 m, in terms of π.
Find the area of a circle with diameter 12 in, in terms of π.
A bike wheel has a diameter of 26 in. How far does it roll in one turn, in terms of π?
Lena says a circle with radius 5 cm has circumference 25π cm. Is she right? Explain, and find the circumference.
items.answer: 10π cm (No: 25π is the area; circumference is 2πr)
